AddClipLayoutRequest.description: Add a layout to a clip

cameraStyle.description: The camera's frame shape, as the editor's Camera style picker sets it, overriding the named layout's own: `circle`, `square`, `portrait`, `none` (a rectangle in the camera slot's aspect, rounded by the clip's `corners`, e.g. a squircle when corners are `squircle`), `cutout` (the presenter cut out of the camera feed with no frame or room, in the layout's camera position — e.g. `camera-bubble` with `style: full` and `position: bottom-left` for a full-screen recording with a cut-out presenter in the corner; it switches pop-out off), `blob` or `blob-outline`. It shapes the camera bubble and the pop-out frame. Null clears it so the layout's own shape applies; omitted leaves it as it is. Needs a camera recording and a named layout that frames the camera (not cut-out, screen-only or custom; on a custom layout set `presentation.shape`).

crop.description: Crop the clip's screen recording for this layout only — the editor's crop modal on “This layout only”. Other layouts keep following the clip's crop; `null` makes this layout follow it again. Masks that start in the layout stay anchored to their content, and a custom layout's screen box keeps its on-canvas scale unless the same request writes `layout` geometry. Needs a screen recording or an uploaded video in the clip. To crop the recording across the whole clip use auto-crop.

durationMs.description: Optional. Provide together with startTimeMs for a time-ranged layout. Minimum 200ms.

layout.description: Layout shape. May be omitted when media is provided to use the default full-frame B-roll layout.

media.description: Optional media content to show during this layout. Only valid on time-ranged layouts.

popOut.description: Pop the presenter out of the camera frame. Omitted or null leaves it off.

startTimeMs.description: Optional. Provide together with durationMs for a time-ranged layout. In ms on the clip's playback timeline (cuts applied).

transitionStyle.description: Optional. Only valid on time-ranged layouts. Defaults to the user's saved layout intro transition when omitted. The user's saved layout outro transition is applied when the following layout begins or resumes.

AddClipMaskRequest.description: Add a blur or highlight mask. Targets the footage in the clip's Screen slot at startTimeMs: the screen recording, or b-roll media a layout puts there. Times are in ms on the clip's playback timeline (cuts applied).

intensity.description: Strength from 0 to 1. Blur: 0 is the standard blur and 1 blurs three times as heavily; the content stays fully hidden at every value (defaults to 0). Highlight: how dark the area outside the highlight goes, 0 = no dimming, 1 = black (defaults to 0.7).

startTimeMs.description: Start time in ms on the clip's playback timeline (cuts applied)

transition.description: `smooth` fades the mask in and out, `hard_cut` pops it. New masks start on `hard_cut`.

AddClipOverlayRequest.description: Add an image or video overlay to a clip. Upload the bytes via `POST /v1/sources` (`kind: image` or `kind: video`) and pass the `sourceId`; the overlay type follows the source's kind. Or pass `motionDocumentId` to show a Tella Motion document of the video's. When `point`/`dimensions` are omitted, a centered box is computed from the source.

motionDocumentId.description: In place of `sourceId`: a Tella Motion document of this video's (ffd_…, from `POST /v1/motion/documents`), shown as the overlay. It is linked, not copied: it plays live, so edits to the document show in the video at once.

sourceId.description: Source ID from `POST /v1/sources` (`kind: image` or `kind: video`). The overlay type follows the source's kind. Pass this or `motionDocumentId`.

startTimeMs.description: Start time. Milliseconds on the clip playback timeline (with cuts applied) — the same timeline as the cut transcript.

transition.description: Intro/outro animation: `smooth` fades the overlay in at its start and out at its end, `hard_cut` pops it in and out. An `animation` replaces it while set.

AddClipRequest.description: Add a new clip from an uploaded source.

name.description: Clip name. Defaults to the next `Clip N`.

AddClipShapeOverlayRequest.description: Add a shape overlay to a clip. Defaults: a square in Tella purple, no border or shadow. When `point`/`dimensions` are omitted it is a centered square a third of the artboard's longer side.

border.description: A line just inside the outline, or null for none.

corners.description: How a square's corners are rounded.

fill.description: What fills the shape, cut to its outline: any clip background except `ambient`. A solid `#00000000` leaves only the border.

path.description: A custom outline as SVG path data (`d`) in a 0–100 box; it stretches with the overlay box. Sending it makes the shape a `path`. Closed subpaths (ending in Z) are filled; an open path shows only its `border`, drawn centred on the line.

startTimeMs.description: Start time. Milliseconds on the clip playback timeline (with cuts applied) — the same timeline as the cut transcript.

transition.description: Intro/outro animation: `smooth` fades the shape in and out, `hard_cut` pops it. An `animation` replaces it while set.

AddClipSoundEffectRequest.description: Add a sound effect to a clip, from Tella's curated catalog (`presetId`) or from your own audio (`sourceId`).

presetId.description: Preset ID of a curated Tella sound effect, from a `default` item in `GET /v1/library?scope=default`. Placing one copies the effect into a source owned by your workspace, so nothing needs uploading. Mutually exclusive with `sourceId`; exactly one is required.

sourceId.description: Source ID for the audio, from `POST /v1/sources` (`kind: audio` with the audio's duration) or from a `private`/`workspace` item in `GET /v1/library?type=sound-effect`. When uploading, send the audio file as-is — MP3, WAV, M4A, … — no need to wrap it in an MP4. Mutually exclusive with `presetId`; exactly one is required.

startTimeMs.description: Start time. Milliseconds on the clip playback timeline (with cuts applied) — the same timeline as the cut transcript.

volume.description: Playback volume (0 = muted, 1 = original). Defaults to 1.

AddClipTextOverlayRequest.description: Add a text overlay to a clip. Nothing needs uploading — pass the copy directly. When `point`/`dimensions` are omitted, a centered box 60% of the artboard wide and 25% tall is used.

background.description: Background behind the text. Defaults to transparent.

color.description: Defaults to white.

fontFamily.description: One of Tella's catalog font families. Defaults to Inter. Anything outside the catalog is rejected rather than silently falling back; use `fontId` for an uploaded font.

fontSize.description: Font size in artboard pixels. Defaults to 7.5% of the video's shorter side, which is the editor's default and readable at any canvas size.

fontWeight.description: Variable-font weight axis — 100 (thin) to 900 (black), 500 by default. Values outside the chosen font's own axis range are clamped when rendered.

fontWidth.description: Variable-font width axis, as a percentage — 100 is normal, 50 ultra-condensed, 150 extra-expanded, 100 by default. Values outside the chosen font's own axis range are clamped when rendered.

outline.description: Defaults to no outline, or the preset's.

presetId.description: A preset from GET /v1/text-presets — `default:<id>` for a built-in style or a saved preset's ID. Supplies the font, weight, width, color, size, alignment, tracking, background, background shape, background padding and outline (not the shadow); any of those fields sent alongside overrides the preset's value.

startTimeMs.description: Start time. Milliseconds on the clip playback timeline (with cuts applied) — the same timeline as the cut transcript.

transition.description: Intro/outro animation: `smooth` fades the text in at its start and out at its end, `hard_cut` pops it in and out. An `animation` replaces it while set.

AddClipZoomRequest.description: Add a zoom to the footage in the clip's Screen slot at startTimeMs — the screen recording, or b-roll media a layout puts there (the camera is unaffected). Use `manualZoom` with a `focusPoint`, or `trackingZoom` to follow the cursor.

introTransition.description: How the zoom enters: `smooth` (the default) animates in, `hard_cut` jumps straight in.

outroTransition.description: How the zoom leaves: `smooth` (the default) animates out, `hard_cut` jumps straight back.

scale.description: Magnification factor (1 = no zoom, 3.5 = max). Required — a zoom without a scale cannot be rendered.

startTimeMs.description: Start time in ms on the clip's playback timeline (cuts applied)

type.description: `manualZoom` zooms into a fixed `focusPoint` on the screen. `trackingZoom` automatically follows the cursor in the screen recording.

Lottie overlays share the stack but aren't listed, so listed values can skip a number. A value past the top moves the overlay to the front; the other overlays keep their relative order.

CameraBubbleLayout.description: Floating camera bubble over the screen recording. Combi (all ratios). Position is 9-way. Set `style: full` to put the screen fullscreen behind the bubble.

screenFit.description: Only honoured when `style: "full"`. Defaults to cover.

shape.description: Defaults to `circle`, as in the editor's Camera Bubble picker.

style.description: `regular` (default) keeps the screen layered behind the bubble; `full` puts the screen fullscreen behind the bubble (and honours `screenFit`).

CameraBubbleLayout.title: Camera Bubble

CameraOnlyLayout.description: Camera fills the frame or sits centered; the screen is hidden. Combi (all ratios).

punchIn.description: Only allowed when `style: "fullscreen"`; `punchIn: true` with `style: "middle"` is rejected. Defaults to false.

shape.description: Required when `style: "middle"`, rejected otherwise. Allowed shapes vary by ratio (no `portrait` in portrait clips, no `square` in square clips).

style.description: `fullscreen` fills the frame with the camera (optional `punchIn`); `middle` centers a shaped camera (requires `shape`).

CameraOnlyLayout.title: Camera Only

activeWordTextColor.description: Text color of the spoken word when highlightMode is background. Defaults to textColor.

backgroundColor.description: Caption background color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA form. Its alpha channel is rendered exactly; #RRGGBB is fully opaque. Responses use uppercase #RRGGBBAA and report the effective rendered color.

backgroundPadding.description: Extra room around the caption text inside its background, as a fraction of the font size added on every side. Defaults to 0, the style's standard padding. No effect while backgroundEnabled is false.

highlightMode.description: How the spoken word is emphasized. Defaults to text.

outlineColor.description: Hex color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA form. Responses use uppercase #RRGGBBAA.

shadowColor.description: Hex color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA form. Responses use uppercase #RRGGBBAA.

textCase.description: Letter case applied to every caption word. Defaults to original.

textColor.description: Hex color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA form. Responses use uppercase #RRGGBBAA.

wordLevelHighlights.description: Highlight each word as it is spoken. Defaults to false.

CaptionFontFamily.description: Subtitle font family. On write, one of Tella's catalog font families or the built-in subtitle families `Dela Gothic One`, `Lato`, `Georgia`, and `Arial`, or the video's current family to keep an uploaded font. Reads report the family the subtitles render with.

CaptionFontSize.description: Exact subtitle text size, 40 to 200 — the editor's Size slider. `captionSize` is the same setting in buckets (small 40, medium 64, large 80), so a request passes one or the other, not both.

CaptionFontWeight.description: Subtitle font weight, 100 (thin) to 1000. Catalog fonts clamp to their supported range; built-in subtitle fonts outside the catalog snap to an available weight. `Dela Gothic One` uses 400 only; `Arial` uses 400 or 700. Reads report the weight that renders. Sent without `captionFontFamily`, it re-weights the video's current font.

CaptionLinesPerBlock.description: Lines a caption block may span when `captionGrouping` is `chunked`: 1, 2, or 3, or 0 for no limit, where blocks only break on pauses and sentence ends.

CaptionPosition.description: Normalized subtitle position. Applies if subtitles are enabled on the video. Null uses automatic placement.

CaptionStyle.description: Subtitle style. Applies if subtitles are enabled on the video. Background, shadow, and outline colors and toggles are available on every style.

scroll.description: Record a scrolling web page as video instead of a still (default false). Ignored for social posts.

url.description: Public web page or single post on X, Instagram, LinkedIn or TikTok. A missing scheme defaults to HTTPS.

item.description: Finished private library item: image for a still, video for a scrolling page. Place item.sourceId with overlays or layout media. Capture completes synchronously; no generation polling is needed.

category.description: Catalog grouping, for `default` items only — the same grouping the editor's sound effects and background music panels show

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 creation timestamp. Absent for `default` catalog items, which are served from Tella's catalog rather than stored as rows.

durationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds, for time-based media

link.description: For `pinterest`, `arena` and `mymind` items: the page the pin or save links to. For `vintage` items: the film's archive page

name.description: Display name shown in the library

presetId.description: Preset ID, for `default` catalog items only. A preset has no source, so pass this instead of `sourceId`: a `sound-effect` preset goes to `POST /v1/videos/{id}/clips/{clipId}/sound-effects` (placing it copies the effect into a source owned by your workspace), a `music` preset to `PUT /v1/videos/{id}/background-music`.

summary.description: For `mymind` items: mymind's AI summary of the save

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 update timestamp. Absent for `default` catalog items.

url.description: Hosted media URL, for `image`, `screenshot`, `music`, `lut` and `font` items, for `vintage` shots (a preview of the shot), and for `default` catalog items, where it is a publicly fetchable preview of the audio (for `music` presets it is also the track the video will play). API-created images expose this alongside `sourceId`; use `sourceId` to place the image on a clip, since overlays and layout media do not accept URLs. Editor-created `screenshot` items have a URL but no sourceId; use POST /v1/library/screenshots to capture a new placeable image or video.

textColor.description: Hex color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA form. Responses use uppercase #RRGGBBAA.

wordLevelHighlights.description: Highlight each word as it is spoken. Defaults to false.

animatedCursor.description: Whether the clip draws an animated cursor from captured mouse data. Absent when the clip has no screen recording.

borderStyle.description: Border and shadow around the clip's frames — the editor Style panel's Border style. The clip's own value, else the video's. `custom` means the layers were styled one by one or with a retired preset; it can't be written.

cameraCrop.description: The camera's crop; null when uncropped. Absent without a camera.

cameraFocusPoint.description: The camera's focus point (50/50 when never set). Absent without a camera.

corners.description: Corner rounding of the clip's frames — the editor Style panel's Shape: `none` (square), `regular` (rounded) or `squircle` (very rounded). The clip's own value, else the video's.

cuts.description: Time ranges cut from the clip's playback

durationSeconds.description: Effective playback duration of the clip after cuts, in seconds

keepCameraFaceCentered.description: Whether Keep face centered is on. Absent without a camera.

layoutSceneType.description: Determines which layouts can be applied to this clip via `add_layout`. See `BasicSubjectLayoutName`, `CameraSubjectLayoutName`, `CombiLayoutName`.

maxDurationSeconds.description: Total length of the underlying source, in seconds

microphoneVolume.description: This clip's microphone volume override: a number when the clip overrides the video's `microphoneVolume`, null when it follows it, and absent when the clip has no microphone audio to control — either no such track, or a track whose recording carries no audio (a muted mic, or a screen recording made without sharing system audio).

mirrorCamera.description: Whether the clip's camera is mirrored (flipped horizontally). Absent when the clip has no camera.

order.description: Position of the clip within the video

studioSound.description: Effective Studio Sound (AI audio enhancement) state for this clip: the video-level switch minus this clip's opt-out.

systemAudioVolume.description: This clip's system audio (screen or uploaded footage) volume override, with the same three states as `microphoneVolume`.

cameraStyle.description: The camera's frame shape, as the editor's Camera style picker sets it, overriding the named layout's own: `circle`, `square`, `portrait`, `none` (a rectangle in the camera slot's aspect, rounded by the clip's `corners`, e.g. a squircle when corners are `squircle`), `cutout` (the presenter cut out of the camera feed with no frame), `blob` or `blob-outline`. crop.description: The crop of the clip's screen recording while this layout shows — the layout's own crop, else the clip's. Absent when the recording is uncropped.

followsBase.description: True when this layout follows the clip's base layout: updating the `base` layout changes it too, so it needs no update of its own. False when it has its own layout. Absent on the base layout itself.

layout.description: Structured layout for this section. Custom layouts, whether arranged in the editor or written through the API, report their geometry as `kind: custom`. Null only for internal layouts outside the public vocabulary.

media.description: B-roll media on this layout — one entry per filled slot (screen and/or camera). Empty on the base layout and on layouts whose underlying section carries no media. Each entry's `slot` says which slot it fills.

popOut.description: The camera's pop-out while this layout shows. Absent when it is off.

transitionStyle.description: Transition into this layout. Omitted on the base layout, or when the section uses an internal style not exposed via the public API.

ClipMask.description: A blur or highlight mask on a clip. Times are in ms on the clip's playback timeline (cuts applied). Internally the mask stays anchored to the footage, so it doesn't drift when cuts change later.

intensity.description: Strength from 0 to 1. Blur: 0 is the standard blur and 1 blurs three times as heavily; the content stays fully hidden at every value (defaults to 0). Highlight: how dark the area outside the highlight goes, 0 = no dimming, 1 = black (defaults to 0.7).

startTimeMs.description: Start time in ms on the clip's playback timeline (cuts applied)

transition.description: `smooth` fades the mask in and out, `hard_cut` pops it. New masks start on `hard_cut`.

ClipMedia.description: Media shown during a layout. `image` or `video`, each referencing a `sourceId` from `POST /v1/sources`, `recording`, a moment from the clip's own recording, or `motion`, a Tella Motion document of the video's.

ClipMediaImage.description: Image media. The image fills the section's layer per the chosen layoutName.

slot.description: Which slot the media fills: `screen` (the subject/main frame, the default) or `camera` (the bubble/presentation slot — a media bubble over the recording behind it). A `camera` slot requires a layout that renders the camera (e.g. camera-bubble, side-by-side, tv-presenter).

muted.description: True when video media plays with its own audio silenced.

ClipOverlay.description: An image, video or Tella Motion overlay on a clip.

animation.description: How the overlay enters and leaves, or null when it plays its `transition`.

imageUrl.description: Hosted image URL, for image overlays. Read-only: not accepted as input — pass `sourceId` instead.

motionDocumentId.description: The Tella Motion document (ffd_…) a `motion` overlay plays. Edit it with `POST /v1/motion/documents/{id}/commands`.

ClipPopOut.description: Pop-out for the camera: the presenter is cut out of the camera feed and rises out of a frame that sits behind their head. The frame's outline follows the layout's `cameraStyle`: the circle style gives a circle, never an ellipse, as wide as the slot's shorter side; the blob style an animated blob; any other style a rectangle in the slot's aspect, rounded by the clip's `corners`. Set `cameraStyle` (e.g. `none` with squircle `corners` for a squircle frame) when the outline is not what the user asked for. Needs a camera recording on the clip and a layout that frames it (any camera layout except cut-out and screen-only). Every field is optional; a write merges over the layout's current settings, and a fresh pop-out takes the defaults for unset fields. Responses report every field.

amount.description: How far the frame shrinks below the presenter, as a fraction of the camera slot (0–0.5). Defaults to 0.22.

background.description: What fills the frame behind the presenter: `original` keeps the camera feed, `color` paints `color`. Defaults to `original`.

color.description: Frame fill when `background` is `color`, as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Defaults to #6366F1.

outlineColor.description: Outline colour as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Defaults to #FFFFFF.

outlineWidth.description: Outline around the frame as a fraction of its width (0–0.05); 0 draws none. Defaults to 0.

ClipShapeOverlay.description: A shape overlay on a clip: a square, circle, star… filled with any clip background.

corners.description: How a square's corners are rounded.

fill.description: What fills the shape, cut to its outline.

path.description: SVG path data in a 0–100 box, for shapeType `path`; null otherwise.

ClipShapeOverlayResponse.description: A shape overlay on a clip

ClipSoundEffect.description: A sound effect on a clip.

startTimeMs.description: Start time. Milliseconds on the clip playback timeline (with cuts applied) — the same timeline as the cut transcript.

ClipSoundEffectResponse.description: A sound effect on a clip

medium.description: Recording medium (Mic, CameraMic, Screen, ScreenMic, Video, None)

url.description: Signed URL to the original source media. Only present for callers who may export raw sources: editors of the video, or anyone with access when the video allows both downloads and raw downloads.

volume.description: This clip's volume override for the source, or null when it plays at the video's `microphoneVolume`/`systemAudioVolume`.

background.description: Background behind the text. Overlays with no visible box report a solid #00000000.

color.description: Hex color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA form. Responses use uppercase #RRGGBBAA.

fontFamily.description: The overlay's font family. Normally one of the catalog families accepted on write, or a library font's family when `fontId` is set. Overlays created before that catalog can report another bundled family, such as `Graphik`.

fontId.description: The library font the overlay renders with (a `font` item's id), absent for a catalog family.

fontSize.description: Font size in artboard pixels — absolute, like `dimensions`, so text keeps its size relative to the frame. Renderers scale it by their render scale factor.

fontWidth.description: Variable-font width axis, as a percentage — 100 is normal, 50 ultra-condensed, 150 extra-expanded.

startTimeMs.description: Start time. Milliseconds on the clip playback timeline (with cuts applied) — the same timeline as the cut transcript.

transition.description: Intro/outro animation: `smooth` fades the text in at its start and out at its end, `hard_cut` pops it in and out. New text overlays start on `hard_cut`. An `animation` replaces it while set.

ClipTextOverlayResponse.description: A text overlay on a clip

words.description: Words on the playback timeline (cuts removed, times relative to the clip's playback start). Word indices are stable — they don't shift when cuts change; words inside cuts are simply absent.

sentences.description: Sentences on the playback timeline (cuts removed), split at `.`, `?` and `!`. Word indices can have gaps where words were cut.

text.description: The transcript on the playback timeline (cuts removed) as plain text: one sentence per line, split at `.`, `?` and `!`, starting with the sentence's start time as `[m:ss.s]`, then each word as `index:word`. Word indices can have gaps where words were cut.

ClipTransition.description: How a clip enters from the previous one. `default` inherits the video's `defaultClipTransition`; `smooth` and `hard_cut` override it for this clip. The first clip in a video has nothing to transition from.

words.description: Every word of the clip's recording in order, including the ones cuts removed (`includeCut=true`).

ClipZoom.description: A zoom effect applied to the footage in the clip's Screen slot — the screen recording, or b-roll media a layout puts there (the camera is unaffected). Use `manualZoom` with a `focusPoint`, or `trackingZoom` to follow the cursor automatically. Times are in ms on the clip's playback timeline (cuts applied). Internally the zoom stays anchored to the footage, so it doesn't drift when cuts change later.

durationMs.description: Duration in ms of playback. 0 when the zoom's footage is entirely cut out.

introTransition.description: How the zoom enters: `smooth` (the default) animates in, `hard_cut` jumps straight in.

outroTransition.description: How the zoom leaves: `smooth` (the default) animates out, `hard_cut` jumps straight back.

startTimeMs.description: Start time in ms on the clip's playback timeline (cuts applied)

type.description: `manualZoom` zooms into a fixed `focusPoint` on the screen. `trackingZoom` automatically follows the cursor in the screen recording.

role.description: Role to grant. Allowed values: 'editor' or 'viewer'.

CreateEndpointRequest.description: Request body for creating a webhook endpoint

filterTypes.description: Event types to subscribe to (e.g., video.created, export.ready)

url.description: The URL where webhook events will be sent

CreateEndpointResponse.description: Response when a webhook endpoint is created

id.description: Unique identifier for the webhook endpoint

secret.description: Signing secret for verifying webhook payloads (shown only once)

CreateGenerationRequest.description: Start generating media from a prompt

durationSeconds.description: For `video` only: the clip's length in whole seconds, 4-30 on `seedance-2.5` and 4-15 on the 2.0 models. Defaults to 5. A longer clip costs proportionally more credits and takes longer to generate.

model.description: Which model to use. For `image`, a GPT Image 2.6 model: `sunburst` (default) is the most capable and follows reference images most precisely; `flare` is faster. For `video`, a Seedance model: `seedance-2.5` is the default and has the best quality (1080p); `seedance-2.0-fast` is quicker and cheaper (720p); `seedance-2.0-mini` is the cheapest (720p). Not accepted for `sound-effect`.

prompt.description: What to generate. Up to 4000 characters for an image, 2000 for a video or a sound effect.
prompt.example: A watercolor illustration of a lighthouse at dawn

referenceSourceId.description: For `image` and `video` only: the `sourceId` of an image source to guide the generation — from `POST /v1/sources` (`kind: "image"`) after uploading the bytes, or an `image` library item's `sourceId`.

CreateGenerationResponse.description: The generation that was started, plus the weekly allowance for sound effects

limit.description: For `sound-effect`, the caller's weekly AI generation allowance, which depends on the plan. Images and videos are charged in the workspace's credits instead and have no weekly allowance: they report 1000000

remaining.description: For `sound-effect`, generations left in the current week, after this one; 1000000 for images and videos

resetAt.description: For `sound-effect`, when the weekly allowance resets, as a millisecond epoch; 0 for images and videos

CreateLibraryItemRequest.description: Save an uploaded source to the library so it can be listed and reused later, or, with `from`, bring in an image you saved in a connected Pinterest, Are.na or mymind account, or a vintage film shot. LUT sources must be valid 3D .cube files with LUT_3D_SIZE at most 65. Apply a saved LUT using its item id in PATCH /v1/videos/{id}/clips/{clipId}/filters. Font sources must be .ttf or .otf files of at most 20 MB; the item is named after the font's family and its id is a text overlay's `fontId`.

from.description: Bring an image in from your connected Pinterest, Are.na or mymind account, or a shot from Tella's `vintage` film catalog, instead of saving an uploaded source. Tella copies it, and the returned item's `sourceId` places it like any other image or video.

name.description: Display name shown in the library. Defaults to the item's type, or for a `vintage` shot, the film's title and year.

scope.description: Where to save the item (default: `private`). `workspace` shares it with everyone in the workspace and requires an owner or member role; viewers get a 403. `video`, with `from` set to `pinterest`, `arena` or `mymind` only, saves it to the library of the video named by `videoId`.

sourceId.description: Source ID from `POST /v1/sources`, with the bytes already uploaded to its `uploadUrl`. With `from`, the `id` of an item from `GET /v1/library?scope=<from>` instead.

type.description: Expected item type. Optional — the type is taken from the source's own kind; supplying a value that disagrees is an error.

videoId.description: With `from` and `scope: "video"`: the video whose media library the image is saved to. Requires edit access to that video.

CreateMotionClipRequest.description: A new clip at the end of the video that plays a blank Tella Motion document of its own, as large as the video and `duration` seconds long (10 when absent), or your document `documentId`. Without `videoId`, a new video as large as that document. The clip lasts as long as its document.

documentId.description: A Tella Motion document of yours that no video plays yet, for the clip to play instead of a blank one. The video takes it over.

duration.description: How long the clip plays, in seconds (default 10): the blank document's canvas length. Not with `documentId`, whose document keeps its own length.

name.description: The clip's name, and the new video's when there is no `videoId`.

videoId.description: The video (vid_…) to add the clip to. Leave it out, with `documentId`, for a new video.

CreateMotionDocumentRequest.description: A blank document, owned by a video for an overlay or b-roll you build in place, or by you until a video takes it over. It is not put in the media library. Its canvas is 10 s long until a `canvas.set` op changes it.

height.description: Canvas height in pixels. Defaults to the video's, or 1080 without a video.

videoId.description: The video (vid_…) that owns the document. Leave it out for one of your own that no video plays yet: the first video it is placed in takes it over.

width.description: Canvas width in pixels. Defaults to the video's, or 1920 without a video.

CreatePlaylistGroupRequest.description: Request to create a playlist group

emoji.description: Unicode emoji character for the group

visibility.description: Where the group lives. Default: personal

CreatePlaylistRequest.description: Request body for creating a new playlist

emoji.description: Unicode emoji character for the playlist

password.description: Password for viewing. Required when linkScope is 'password', ignored otherwise.

visibility.description: Share with org or keep personal (default: personal)

CreateSourceRequest.description: Create a new source upload (video, audio, image, 3D .cube LUT, or font). Returns a pre-signed S3 URL to PUT the bytes to, plus a `sourceId` to reference from clips, layouts, overlays, backgrounds, and sound effects. For a LUT, upload the .cube unchanged and save it with POST /v1/library; use the returned library item id with PATCH /v1/videos/{id}/clips/{clipId}/filters. For a font, upload the .ttf or .otf unchanged and save it with POST /v1/library; use the returned library item id as a text overlay's `fontId`.

duration.description: Duration in seconds. Required for `video` and `audio`; omit for `image`, `lut` and `font`.

height.description: Height in pixels. Required for `video` and `image`; omit for `audio`, `lut` and `font`.

kind.description: Source kind: `video` (default), `audio` (e.g. sound effects), `image`, `lut` (a 3D .cube LUT), or `font` (a .ttf or .otf file). A `video` upload needs a paid plan and is refused during the free trial.

width.description: Width in pixels. Required for `video` and `image`; omit for `audio`, `lut` and `font`.

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which `uploadUrl` stops accepting uploads.

uploadUrl.description: Pre-signed S3 URL. PUT the file bytes here (single PUT, max ~5GB). Upload the file as-is: any common container is accepted (MP4, MOV, WebM, MP3, WAV, M4A, …) — the `.mp4` in the URL path is just the storage key, not a container requirement.

CreateTagRequest.description: Request body for creating a tag

color.description: Hex color (default: derived deterministically from the name)

CreateVideoRequest.description: Request body for creating a video, from an uploaded source or empty.

allowedEmbedDomains.description: Restrict embedding to these domains only (Premium feature). Empty array allows all domains.

autoRatio.description: The editor's Setup → Size → Auto. true sizes the canvas from the video's recording (the first clip with a screen recording, else the first clip's video or image) with the layout's padding equal on all sides, and keeps it following the recording as layouts change; when the canvas changes ratio class, layouts are remapped like a dimensions change. false pins the current size. Pass either autoRatio or dimensions, not both.

captionGrouping.description: How subtitle text is grouped: sentence chunks or one word at a time.

captionPosition.description: Normalized subtitle position; null restores automatic placement. Applies if subtitles are enabled on the video.

captionSize.description: Subtitle text size. Applies if subtitles are enabled on the video.

captionsDefaultEnabled.description: Show subtitles to viewers by default

commentEmailsEnabled.description: Send email notifications for new comments

creatorEnabled.description: Show who created the video on the video page

defaultClipTransition.description: How each clip enters from the previous one. A clip can override it with its own `transition`; see `PATCH /v1/videos/{id}/clips/{clipId}`.

defaultPlaybackRate.description: Default playback speed (0.5-2.0). Viewers can still adjust.

dimensions.description: Canvas size in pixels, at most 1920 per side. This is the layout canvas, not the output resolution: request a 4K file with `resolution: "4k"` on `POST /v1/videos/{id}/exports`. Changing it also remaps every clip and section layout to a ratio-appropriate equivalent (clips using a custom layout fall back to a standard one), exactly like switching size in the editor's Setup → Size. No-op when the video already has the requested size. The editor's presets: 1920x1080 (16:9), 1920x1200 (16:10), 1440x1080 (4:3), 1080x1080 (1:1), 1080x1350 (4:5), 1080x1920 (9:16).

downloadsEnabled.description: Allow viewers to download the video

eyeContact.description: Eye contact correction for every camera recording in the video: AI redirects the speaker's gaze to the lens. `true` starts preparing each camera in the background (about as long as the recording); `false` restores the natural look. The response's `settings.eyeContact` shows the switch as asked for with `status: "processing"`; read the video until it is `ready`. Screen recordings and uploaded videos are never changed. Returns 400 when turning it on for a video with no camera recording.

layoutAnimationStyle.description: How layout transitions animate, gentlest to snappiest. Changing it leaves zooms as they were: when zooms have no `zoomAnimationStyle` of their own, they keep the previous style.

linkScope.description: Access level: public (anyone with link), private (org members only), password (requires password), embedonly (only viewable when embedded)

microphoneVolume.description: Volume of the microphone (webcam) audio across the whole video. 1 is the recorded level, 0 mutes it, 2 doubles it. Clips that set their own `microphoneVolume` keep it — change or clear those with `PATCH /v1/videos/{id}/clips/{clipId}`.

motionBlur.description: Blur fast zoom, pan, and cursor movement. Defaults on for new videos.

motionBlurAmount.description: Motion blur strength, the editor's Motion blur slider: 0.1 (subtle) to 2 (strong), 1 is the default. Setting it turns motion blur on, so it can't be combined with `motionBlur: false`.

password.description: Password for viewing. Required when linkScope is 'password', ignored otherwise.

publishDateEnabled.description: Show publish date on video page

rawDownloadsEnabled.description: Allow viewers to download raw source files

searchEngineIndexingEnabled.description: Allow search engines to index the video page

shrinkCameraDuringZooms.description: Shrink camera bubbles while a zoom is active. Defaults on.

sourceId.description: Source ID from POST /v1/sources (kind: 'video'). Upload the video bytes to the source's uploadUrl first; the source becomes the new video's first clip. Leave it out for an empty video, as the editor's New video makes: add clips with POST /v1/videos/{id}/clips or POST /v1/motion/clips.

studioSound.description: Studio Sound (AI audio enhancement) master switch. Enabling it also starts generating the enhanced audio tracks in the background; playback and exports use them once ready and fall back to the raw audio until then.

studioSoundLevel.description: Studio Sound level, as in the editor's Studio Voice panel. `low` and `high` turn Studio Sound on at that strength and regenerate the enhanced audio tracks when the level changes; `off` turns it off. Pass this or `studioSound`, or both when they agree.

systemAudioVolume.description: Volume of the system/screen audio across the whole video — everything that is not microphone audio. 1 is the recorded level, 0 mutes it, 2 doubles it. Clips that set their own `systemAudioVolume` keep it — change or clear those with `PATCH /v1/videos/{id}/clips/{clipId}`.

viewCountEnabled.description: Show view count on video page

zoomAnimationStyle.description: How zooms ease in, out, and between each other, gentlest to snappiest. Independent of `layoutAnimationStyle`.

clickRipple.description: Show a ripple on mouse clicks. Defaults off for new videos.

hideWhenInactive.description: Fade the animated cursor out while inactive and back in when activity resumes.

returnToStart.description: Move the cursor back to its opening position at the end for cleaner loops.

smoothing.description: Smooth cursor movement. Defaults off for new videos.

tilt.description: Tilt the cursor in the direction it moves. Defaults off for new videos.

tiltStrength.description: How far the cursor tilts while moving, from 0 (none) to 2 (maximum). Defaults to 0.5 for new videos. Only has an effect when tilt is true.

CursorSettingsUpdate.description: Animated cursor settings to update. Omitted nested fields keep their current values.

clickRipple.description: Show a ripple on mouse clicks. Defaults off for new videos.

hideWhenInactive.description: Fade the animated cursor out while inactive and back in when activity resumes.

returnToStart.description: Move the cursor back to its opening position at the end for cleaner loops.

smoothing.description: Smooth cursor movement. Defaults off for new videos.

tilt.description: Tilt the cursor in the direction it moves. Defaults off for new videos.

tiltStrength.description: How far the cursor tilts while moving, from 0 (none) to 2 (maximum). Defaults to 0.5 for new videos. Only has an effect when tilt is true.

CursorStyle.description: Animated cursor artwork. mac is the pre-Tahoe style; macTahoe and macGoldenGate match those macOS generations; windows and touch use platform-specific artwork.

CustomLayout.description: Explicit geometry per slot in artboard pixels (the video's `dimensions`), like a layout arranged by hand in the editor. Valid on any scene type. Read the clip's layouts first: a section that is already custom merges the fields you pass over its current geometry; any other layout needs full `subject` geometry. Custom layouts can't carry `media` and aren't accepted in batch edits.

presentation.description: The camera on combi clips. When omitted on a clip that has a camera and no custom geometry yet, the camera is kept but hidden.

subject.description: The main layer: the screen recording on combi and basic-subject clips, the camera on camera-subject clips. A screen keeps its recording's aspect ratio: `dimensions` are fitted to it around the same centre.

CustomLayout.title: Custom

CustomLayoutPoint.description: Top-left corner of the slot in artboard pixels.

CustomLayoutSlot.description: Geometry of one slot. `point` and `dimensions` are required unless the layout being written is already custom, in which case omitted fields keep their current values. Responses report every field.

corners.description: Corner rounding of a rectangular frame. Defaults to `regular`.

hidden.description: Leave the layer out of the picture. Defaults to false.

order.description: Stacking order; the lower one draws on top: 0 is the front layer and 1 the layer behind it (use only 0 and 1). Defaults to 0 for the subject and 1 for the presentation.

shape.description: Frame the layer is drawn in: `none` (default) is the plain rectangle given by `dimensions`; `circle`, `square` and `portrait` are the camera-bubble frames; `cutout` cuts the presenter out of the camera feed; `blob` is a wobbling bubble that grows toward the presenter's hands, and `blob-outline` is the same with a white line around it.

Cut.description: A range of the raw recording removed from playback. Cut definitions are the one place raw-recording coordinates appear: replacing the cut set describes the playback timeline you'd get after clearing all cuts. Cuts are always undoable — replace with `[]` to restore everything.

durationMs.description: Length of the cut, in milliseconds

startTimeMs.description: Start of the cut, in ms of the raw recording

CutClipByTranscriptRequest.description: Cut one or more ranges from the clip by referencing word indices in the transcript. Indices are stable across cuts (already-cut words are simply absent). The server resolves each range to exact word times and merges the resulting cuts.

wordRanges.description: Word ranges to cut. Each range's start and end ms are read directly from the transcript — no padding is applied.

CutClipRequest.description: Cut one or more time ranges from the clip in a single request. Provide either `cuts: [{fromMs, toMs}, ...]` (preferred) or the legacy single-range `fromMs`/`toMs` pair. Overlapping or adjacent ranges are merged into the clip's existing cuts.

cuts.description: Time ranges to cut from the clip. Merged with the clip's existing cuts; overlapping or adjacent ranges are joined.

fromMs.description: Single-range shortcut for `cuts: [{fromMs, toMs}]`. Use `cuts` for multiple ranges.

toMs.description: Single-range shortcut for `cuts: [{fromMs, toMs}]`. Use `cuts` for multiple ranges.

CutOutLayout.description: The presenter is cut out of the footage (person matting). On combi clips they are blended over the screen recording; on camera-subject clips or basic-subject clips whose subject is an uploaded video, they cover the frame over the story background. Screen-only recordings are not supported: using cut-out on them returns 400. Use fullscreen or middle instead.

position.description: Combi clips only (required there): which side the cut-out presenter sits on in landscape. Portrait and square stories stack the two instead — `right` puts the presenter at the top, `left` at the bottom. Ignored on camera-subject clips.

style.description: Landscape combi clips only. `regular` (default) places the screen beside the presenter; `perspective` fills most of the canvas with the screen, angled away toward the presenter, who stands in front in the bottom corner on `position`'s side.

CutOutLayout.title: Cut Out

CutOutput.description: A range of the raw recording removed from playback. Cut definitions are the one place raw-recording coordinates appear: replacing the cut set describes the playback timeline you'd get after clearing all cuts. Cuts are always undoable — replace with `[]` to restore everything.

durationMs.description: Length of the cut, in milliseconds

startTimeMs.description: Start of the cut, in ms of the raw recording

CutRange.description: A single time range to cut from the clip, in ms on the clip's playback timeline (what you currently see and hear — the same timeline as the transcript and detected silences). All ranges in one request are resolved against the playback timeline as it is when the request starts.

fromMs.description: Start of the range to cut, in ms on the clip's playback timeline.

toMs.description: End of the range to cut, in ms on the clip's playback timeline. Clamped to the clip's playable duration.

DeleteEndpointResponse.description: Response when a webhook endpoint is deleted

DuplicateClipRequest.description: Request body for duplicating a clip

name.description: Name for the duplicated clip (defaults to the source clip name)

order.description: Position to insert the new clip (defaults to right after the source)

DuplicateMotionDocumentRequest.description: Copy a document under the same owner. The copy is independent: later edits to either do not reach the other.

commands.description: Edits to run on the copy, as `POST /v1/motion/documents/{id}/commands` takes them, e.g. `setTitle` to give the same title card another heading.

DuplicateMotionDocumentResponse.description: The copy and, with commands, the batch's result

applied.description: With `commands`: the batch's result on the copy.

DuplicateVideoRequest.description: Request body for duplicating a video

name.description: Name for the duplicated video. Defaults to original name with ' (Copy)' suffix.

trim.description: Optional trim parameters. Specify startTime+endTime for time range trim (duration must be at least 1 second), or chapterIndex to extract a specific chapter.

key.description: The signing secret for verifying webhook payloads

ExportStatus.description: Status of a video export job

downloadUrl.description: Download URL when export is completed, null otherwise

exportId.description: Unique identifier for the export job

progress.description: Export progress percentage (0-100), null if not started

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime of last status update

ExportVideoRequest.description: Request body for exporting a video

fps.description: Frames per second. 60 FPS requires the video creator's Premium plan (including Enterprise Premium), or Pro (including Enterprise) for videos up to 5 minutes after cuts. Not available during a free trial.

granularity.description: Export granularity: video (full video), clips (one composed file per clip), tracks (camera and screen files per clip with timeline cuts applied), raw (original recordings without cuts)

resolution.description: Export resolution. Default is 1080p. 4K requires the video creator's paid plan and is not available during a free trial.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier. Any speed other than 1 requires the video creator's paid plan and is not available during a free trial.

FullscreenLayout.description: Single-layer fullscreen. Takes an optional `style` (regular/stretch); basic-subject clips also take an optional `screenFit`.

screenFit.description: Only honoured for basic-subject clips (Tella renders the screen fullscreen). Defaults to cover.

style.description: `regular` (default) is plain fullscreen; `stretch` punches in to 1.15x. On basic-subject clips `stretch` needs uploaded footage (not a screen recording).

FullscreenLayout.title: Fullscreen

GenerateAutoZoomsRequest.description: Automatically generate tracking zooms from the mouse clicks in the clip's screen recording — the API twin of the editor's "Generate zooms". Warning: by default this replaces the clip's existing tracking zooms (see `replaceExisting`).

intensity.description: The editor's zoom preset: `gentle` (1.5x, the calmest, easing in softly), `subtle` (1.5x, slow and smooth), `moderate` (default, 2x), `focused` (2x, settles fast) or `intense` (2.5x, snappy). It also sets the clip's zoom animation style. `slow`, `medium` and `fast` mean subtle, moderate and intense.

replaceExisting.description: Defaults to true: the clip's existing tracking zooms are REMOVED before the generated ones are added, so repeated calls regenerate instead of stacking. Pass false to keep existing tracking zooms. Manual zooms are never touched.

scale.description: Override the magnification factor (1 = no zoom, 3.5 = max). Defaults to the preset's scale (1.5 for gentle and subtle, 2 for moderate and focused, 2.5 for intense).

GenerateAutoZoomsResponse.description: Zooms generated from the clip's mouse activity

zooms.description: The generated tracking zooms, in ms on the clip's playback timeline (cuts applied). Empty when the screen recording has no usable mouse clicks.

Generation.description: An AI media generation and, once finished, its library item

error.description: A sanitized, human-readable reason when `status` is `failed`. It may identify a content-safety rejection or timeout, or report a generic failure. Do not parse this text for machine handling.

id.description: Generation ID. It is also the ID of the private library item the result is saved as, so it can be passed to `GET /v1/library/generations/{id}` to poll and shows up in `GET /v1/library?scope=private` once finished.

item.description: The finished library item, present once `status` is `completed`. Pass its `sourceId` anywhere a source is accepted — overlays, layout media, sound effects.

prompt.description: The prompt the media is being generated from
prompt.example: A watercolor illustration of a lighthouse at dawn

GenerationStatus.description: `pending` and `running` mean the generator is still working — poll again in a few seconds. `completed` means `item` is ready to place. `failed` is final; start a new generation.

GenerationType.description: The kind of media to generate

GetAccountResponse.description: The signed-in user, their workspace, its plan and credits

GetClipResponse.description: Response shape for a single clip

GetExportResponse.description: Current status of a video export

status.description: `pending`: the upload hasn't finished yet. Video and audio start converting as soon as it does, and images are prepared for rendering within a few seconds; LUTs and fonts are ready right away. `processing`: still uploading or converting; frames and previews of videos using it answer not-ready until it is `ready`, so poll this every few seconds. `ready`: usable everywhere. `failed`: conversion failed or the recording was cancelled; upload the file again as a new source.

GetTimelineResponse.description: A compact video timeline with optional video-level and clip-level details

clips.description: Complete clip outline in playback order

details.description: Present only when at least one detail category is requested

included.description: Detail categories included in this response

backgroundColor.description: Caption background color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA form. Its alpha channel is rendered exactly; #RRGGBB is fully opaque. Responses use uppercase #RRGGBBAA and report the effective rendered color.

backgroundPadding.description: Extra room around the caption text inside its background, as a fraction of the font size added on every side. Defaults to 0, the style's standard padding. No effect while backgroundEnabled is false.

highlightColor.description: Hex color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA form. Responses use uppercase #RRGGBBAA.

highlightMode.description: How the spoken word is emphasized. Defaults to background.

outlineColor.description: Hex color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA form. Responses use uppercase #RRGGBBAA.

primaryTextColor.description: Hex color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA form. Responses use uppercase #RRGGBBAA.

secondaryTextColor.description: Hex color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA form. Responses use uppercase #RRGGBBAA.

shadowColor.description: Hex color in #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA form. Responses use uppercase #RRGGBBAA.

textCase.description: Letter case applied to every caption word. Defaults to original.

wordLevelHighlights.description: Highlight each word as it is spoken. Defaults to true.

error.description: Why the import failed, set when `status` is `failed`

id.description: The library item the import is saved as; poll with it

item.description: The finished library item, set when `status` is `completed`: an `image` for a still, a `video` for a scrolling page or video link. Place `item.sourceId` with overlays or layout media.

status.description: Page and post captures are `completed` at once; video links are `running` until downloaded

KeystrokeSettings.description: The keystroke HUD: the keys pressed during Mac app screen recordings and Auto Capture takes, drawn over the video as they were typed.

alignment.description: Which horizontal edge of the HUD sits on position.x.

animation.description: How each chord enters and leaves. The text sides are always null.

displayDurationMs.description: How long a chord lingers after its key is released, in milliseconds.

filter.description: `shortcuts` shows only chords with a modifier, such as ⌘C or ⇧Tab, and hides typing, capitals and shifted symbols included; `all` also shows plain typing, including any text typed while recording.

labels.description: The keyboard the keys are labelled for. Absent, each recording's own keyboard: ⌘ for the Mac app, Ctrl for Auto Capture takes.

position.description: Anchor of the HUD as a fraction of the frame. `alignment` says which horizontal edge of the HUD sits on x.

size.description: Size multiplier from 0.5 to 4 (1 is a 44 px cap on a 1080p frame).

style.description: `keycap` draws one rounded cap per key in a container; `pill` draws the chord as text in one box.

typing.description: How `filter: all` shows plain typing. `keys` (the default when absent) shows one key per press; `words` grows a run of typing as text in one chip (backspace trims it; a pause, Return or a shortcut ends it), while shortcuts and keys pressed on their own still show as keys.

KeystrokeSettingsUpdate.description: Keystroke HUD settings to update. Omitted fields keep their current values; `enabled: true` turns it on with the defaults. Only recordings made with the Tella Mac app and Auto Capture takes carry keyboard data.

alignment.description: Which horizontal edge of the HUD sits on position.x.

animation.description: How each chord enters and leaves, with the same sides as an overlay's `animation` (no text sides). Defaults to a 150 ms fade in and a 200 ms fade out.

durationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds, for time-based media

A preset has no source, so pass this instead of `sourceId`: a `sound-effect` preset goes to `POST /v1/videos/{id}/clips/{clipId}/sound-effects` (placing it copies the effect into a source owned by your workspace), a `music` preset to `PUT /v1/videos/{id}/background-music`.

url.description: Hosted media URL, for `image`, `screenshot`, `music`, `lut` and `font` items, for `vintage` shots (a preview of the shot), and for `default` catalog items, where it is a publicly fetchable preview of the audio (for `music` presets it is also the track the video will play). API-created images expose this alongside `sourceId`; use `sourceId` to place the image on a clip, since overlays and layout media do not accept URLs. Editor-created `screenshot` items have a URL but no sourceId; use POST /v1/library/screenshots to capture a new placeable image or video.

MotionCommandAddEffect.description: Adds an effect to a node's stack. `kind: "shader"` runs your own SkSL. `backdrop: true` filters what is beneath the node instead (frosted glass; on a transparent shape, an adjustment layer).

backdrop.description: Filter what is drawn beneath the node's bounds instead of the node (frosted glass; on a transparent shape, an adjustment layer). Pixel filters only.

effectId.description: The effect's id in the node's stack, as inspect_motion_node_properties lists it.

index.description: Place in the stack, 0 innermost (applied first); outermost when left out.

additionalProperties.description: A node's id: ids are unique in the document, so a node inside a composition is named by its id alone. A path through instances (scene.1/title) is accepted too.

inputs.description: For kind shader: each `uniform shader` input, a node of the same composition.

kind.description: An effect kind from list_motion_effects: a render timeline effect type (blur, glow, dropShadow, …), a built-in shader's name (fx.levels, fx.vignette, …), shader for your own SkSL in source, or an audio effect (parametricEq, compressor, reverb, …) for a node's sound, which runs in chain order and takes no backdrop.

node.description: A node's id: ids are unique in the document, so a node inside a composition is named by its id alone. A path through instances (scene.1/title) is accepted too.

params.description: Parameters by name, as list_motion_effects gives them: numbers, #rrggbb(aa) colours, [x, y] points, true/false, an option, or a node path.

preset.description: A preset of the kind, by name from list_motion_effects; list_motion_effects {kind, preset} shows the settings it sets, which params then override.

source.description: For kind shader: SkSL with `uniform shader image;` (the node) and `half4 main(float2 p)`; `uniform float2 resolution` is bound to the node's size. For random values and noise, call the shader library, which Tella adds to your source and which draws the same on every GPU: `tella_hash2d(p)` and `tella_hash3d(p)` (a value in 0..1 per whole-number cell), `tella_noise2d(p)` and `tella_noise3d(p)` (smooth value noise in 0..1) and `tella_fbm2d(p, octaves)` and `tella_fbm3d(p, octaves)` (fractal noise, 1 to 8 octaves). Don't hash with `fract(sin(...))` or `fract(p * k)`: export GPUs round those differently, which draws lines along the noise grid.

uniforms.description: For kind shader: each other uniform's values, as many as it declares (float 1, float2 2, half4 4); the renderer checks them against the SkSL. Each value keys as a property afterwards.

MotionCommandAddMedia.description: Places a video, image or sound: `mediaId` for media already in the document (`list_motion_media`), or `sourceId` for an upload, which Tella reads as the image, video or sound it is.

nodeId.description: The new node's id; generated when left out.

parent.description: Where the new node goes: a sequence, a group, a composition instance (its composition's root), or "" for the canvas. The canvas when left out.

ripple.description: Into a sequence: what starts at start or later moves on to make room, instead of refusing an overlap. A clip that start falls inside is still refused; split it first.

sourceId.description: Or an upload (su_…): a source from create_source, a chat attachment, or a library item's sourceId. Tella reads from the upload whether it is an image, a video or a sound and declares the asset to match. Pass exactly one of mediaId and sourceId.
